title: Adopt Greg's raw-artifact direction on TermAl: Git-ignored .logs/ and .evidence/, removal on task close, instruction wording
outcome: TermAl keeps raw run logs and evidence only in Git-ignored .logs/ and .evidence/ at the repository root, removes them when the associated task closes unless a concrete need is recorded on an item, and its instructions say so in wording concurred with Engram.
acceptance: .gitignore ignores /.logs/ and /.evidence/ at the repository root, and `git check-ignore` confirms both.

CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md (which carries the same section) replace the first bullet of "Work only in the repository folder" with exactly the two bullets concurred in note d0e09f62, identical after whitespace normalisation, landed on master under the authority-file rule: (a) both coordinators' recorded concurrence, (b) Greg sent the exact wording and its corrected consequence, (c) the final-diff audit recorded on this item; and .gitignore ignores /.logs/ and /.evidence/.
